display_name: MCP Task Lifecycle State Machine Validator
purpose: Validate that a long-running MCP task state transitions are legal per the new MCP specification state machine: working to input_required or terminal states (completed, failed, cancelled); input_required back to working or terminal. Flags each illegal jump. Terminal stage of the agent-authorization-lifecycle chain. Exports lifecycle attestation with execution_hash. Zero network, zero PII.
